_meta.description: Правила DQ по материалам. Структура как у rules.json: ключ = имя таблицы SAP, значение = массив правил.
_meta.note: Ключи, начинающиеся с _, checker игнорирует. dm_product_general: MARA + MAKT (MAKTX, exclude %ABP%).

MARA.rule_description: For FG (MTART= ZFG, ZFGS) the value for MEINS should be "CS", "ST" or "PC" in MARA View
technical_definition: ELSE IF material_type_code IN (ZFG, ZFGS) AND base_unit_of_measure_code IN (CS, ST, PC) THEN '1'
ELSE IF material_type_code IN (ZFG, ZFGS) AND base_unit_of_measure_code NOT IN (CS, ST, PC) THEN '0'

MARA.rule_description: For Material Type (MTART)=ZNVL, ZKIT check if MTPOS_MARA = NORM/ZWST in MARA View
technical_definition: ELSE IF (material_type_code IN (ZNVL) AND general_item_category_group_code IN ('NORM', 'ZWST')) OR
ELSE IF (material_type_code IN (ZNVL) AND general_item_category_group_code NOT IN ('NORM', 'ZWST')) OR
(material_type_code IN (ZKIT) AND general_item_category_group_code NOT IN ('NORM')) THEN '0'

MARA.rule_description: For Material Type (MTART)= ZSV check if MTPOS_MARA = LEIS or ZLIS in MARA View
technical_definition: ELSE IF material_type_code IN (ZSV) AND general_item_category_group_code IN ('LEIS', 'ZLIS') THEN '1'
ELSE IF material_type_code IN (ZSV) AND general_item_category_group_code NOT IN ('LEIS', 'ZLIS') THEN '0'
